sentences.text: No, a Tier 4 UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on this floating rate business loan to an MSE sanctioned on 15 March 2026.

The documents also state that for loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026, the paragraph 261 directions apply, and the applicability or otherwise of pre-payment charges must be disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and in the KFS where one is to be provided.
